d:
Krishn ko krishn pukarna ek jhuth hai
Krishn ko radha pukara jana chahie
Mujhe bhi mere nam se bulana ek jhuth hai
Halanki mujhe kisi aur nam se bulae jane par sandeh hai
Mainne kabhi kisi aur se pyar nahin kiya
Lekin mainne tumse kabhi utna pyar nahin kiya
Jitne mainne dave kie—bevfaee ye bhi to hoti hai
Mainne sabse zyada pyar apne aap se kiya hai
